comments.note: PRE-EXISTING (not introduced by WP-002) — A06 Vulnerable Components: System.Text.Json 8.0.0 carries two High-severity DoS advisories: GHSA-hh2w-p6rv-4g7w (CVE-2024-43485, fixed in 8.0.10) and GHSA-8g4q-xg66-9fp4 (CVE-2024-30105, fixed in 8.0.8). Affected projects: VideoIndexer.Infrastructure (via Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration.Json 8.0.0) and VideoIndexer.Tests (same transitive path). This vulnerability existed before WP-002 and is not counted as a blocking finding for this WP. Remediation: add a direct PackageReference for System.Text.Json >= 8.0.10 (or bump all Microsoft.Extensions.* packages to 8.0.10+) in a dedicated security-hygiene WP. Note: DoS exploitability is low for a local desktop tool processing only trusted local JSON files.

A02 / A05 — test-config.dist.json (tests/test-config.dist.json) ships with useSsl: false and username: root. The $comment correctly marks this file as a throwaway local dev template, and test-config.json (the live copy) is properly gitignored. No real credentials are committed. Consider documenting that production-adjacent test environments should use a non-root account and enable TLS (useSsl: true) even for local CI, as a defence-in-depth recommendation for future contributors.

Dapper 2.1.35 resolves against lib/net7.0/Dapper.dll on the net8.0 target — this is expected (netstandard2.0/net7.0 is the highest TFM Dapper 2.x ships). No security implication, but worth tracking when Dapper 3.x ships a net8.0 target to eliminate the TFM fallback.

summary: WP-002 adds MySqlConnector 2.3.7, Dapper 2.1.35, and Xunit.SkippableFact 1.4.13 — three minimal, well-scoped PackageReference additions across two .csproj files. Reviewed against all four dimensions: Maintainability (clean, correctly ordered, commented), Best Practices (idiomatic .NET MySQL stack, correct xunit runner metadata), Performance (MySqlConnector is the top-performing async MySQL driver for .NET), Future Context (packages align with the long-term MySQL+Dapper data-access pattern; SkippableFact is the correct mechanism for live-DB integration test gates). Zero blocking issues found. No executable code was modified — no Fix-Forward opportunities. One Documentation-Forward item logged for the Documentation agent.

comments.note: No blocking or Fix-Forward issues — code is clean and consistent. The three added PackageReferences follow the project's existing style conventions (alphabetical within groups, consistent Version attribute quoting).

[documentation-forward] The purpose of Xunit.SkippableFact in the test project is not documented anywhere in the README or contributor guide. Future contributors should understand that tests decorated with [SkippableFact] require a live MySQL connection and will be skipped when test-config.json is absent or the DB is unreachable. Add a section to the README or a CONTRIBUTING.md note explaining this pattern and how to configure test-config.json from test-config.dist.json.

Pre-existing observation (not introduced by WP-002): Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions is pinned at 8.0.2 while all other Microsoft.Extensions.* packages are at 8.0.0. This minor version drift is harmless but could be aligned in a future housekeeping WP to reduce cognitive overhead when reviewing transitive resolution.
